source_item.title: Iraq devalues dinar to 1,520 per US dollar, state news agency says

card.what_happened_verbose: Iraq's central bank officially set the exchange rate of the Iraqi dinar at 1,520 against the US dollar, a significant devaluation from previous levels. It can also impact foreign investment and remittances.
